name: Nanjou
source: Takara's older brother. At the discretion of his father, who is the family head, when his younger brother Takara was born, he was adopted by a branch family. Therefore, he calls himself Nanjo of the branch family. Originally, he was supposed to succeed the head family as the eldest son, but he was deprived of his position by his younger brother, and he bitterly resents Takara. He gets angry easily and likes bread.
